newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Lai Sun Dev mandates HK$1.5 bln loan.
newsitem.headline: Lai Sun Dev mandates HK$1.5 bln loan.

text.p: Lai Sun Development Co Ltd has mandated Schroders Asia to arrange a HK$1.5 billion term loan facility, bankers said on Tuesday.
The facility has a final maturity of three years with no put or call options. It pays an interest margin of 160 basis points over the Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
Proceeds are to be used for refinancing debt connected with the borrower's Cheung Sha Wan Plaza office complex.
BA Asia, Bankers Trust, Deutsche Bank and Schroders Asia are said to have fully underwritten the deal.
A sub-underwriting group is being formed.
